Tomato___Leaf_Spot.precautions: Avoid spraying during high winds. Wear protective gloves.

Tomato___Late_Blight.application: Spray immediately at first symptoms, repeat every 7 days
Tomato___Late_Blight.precautions: Apply before rain. Do not mix with alkaline pesticides.

Tomato___Early_Blight.application: Foliar spray at first sign of disease, repeat at 7-10 day intervals
Tomato___Early_Blight.precautions: Do not apply more than 3 consecutive sprays. Follow PHI guidelines.

Potato___Late_Blight.application: Preventive spray before disease onset, repeat every 7-10 days
Potato___Late_Blight.precautions: Ensure good coverage on lower leaf surfaces.

Wheat___Leaf_Rust.application: Spray at flag leaf stage or at first sign of rust pustules
Wheat___Leaf_Rust.precautions: Do not apply during flowering to protect pollinators.

Rice___Blast.application: Spray during tillering and panicle initiation stages
Rice___Blast.precautions: Avoid excessive nitrogen fertilization which promotes blast.

Rice___Brown_Spot.application: Spray at booting to heading stage
Rice___Brown_Spot.precautions: Ensure potassium-rich fertilization to reduce disease severity.

Cotton___Aphid_Infestation.application: Spray on undersides of leaves where aphids cluster
Cotton___Aphid_Infestation.precautions: Toxic to bees. Do not spray during flowering.

Grape___Powdery_Mildew.application: Spray every 10-14 days starting from bud break
Grape___Powdery_Mildew.precautions: Do not apply sulphur at temperatures above 35°C.

Maize___Northern_Leaf_Blight.application: Apply at V6-V8 stage if disease pressure is high

Chilli___Anthracnose.application: Spray at fruit formation stage, repeat every 10 days
Chilli___Anthracnose.precautions: Remove and destroy infected fruits to limit spread.

Mango___Powdery_Mildew.application: Pre-bloom spray and repeat at 15-day intervals

Onion___Purple_Blotch.application: Foliar spray at 10-day intervals during humid weather
Onion___Purple_Blotch.precautions: Ensure proper drainage to reduce humidity around plants.

Soybean___Rust.precautions: Monitor regularly as rust spreads rapidly.

Mango___Gall_Midge.application: Foliar spray at young leaf emergence stage to prevent gall formation
Mango___Gall_Midge.precautions: Spray during early morning or late evening. Avoid spraying during bloom.

General___Nutrient_Deficiency.altDosage: 5g per litre of water as foliar spray
General___Nutrient_Deficiency.application: Soil application at sowing or foliar spray during growth
General___Nutrient_Deficiency.precautions: Do not apply excess nitrogen — may promote pest/disease.
